detail.description:
Nearly a hundred new hybrid plant species – Explosive combat power, protect your Plant Home!

Tuoshan Su Su x Bai Yue Chu [Reincarnated Love] officially appears! Join now!
First-time login rewards you with the Legendary Golden Plant - Monkey King Peach, Guanyin Lotus, Epic Purple Plant - Pineapple Fabric and Flower King, along with many high-level upgrade materials and plenty of gold waiting for you!

There are also special outfits – Straw Hat Superhero and special weapons – Sparkling Bamboo Tub
